:::{#def-distribution-model-family}
#### Distribution model family

A **distribution model family** $\distfam$ is a set of [distribution models](#def-distribution-model).
The [mean functions](#def-mean-function) of its members form the set

$$
\cb{\meanfnof{\distmem} : \distmem \in \distfam}.
$$ {#eq-distribution-model-family-mean-functions}

:::
